label: Post-apocalypse
blurb: A survivor settlement years after the collapse: scavengers, mechanics, medics, traders and the odd reformed raider.
context: post-apocalyptic survivor settlement character, in patched, scavenged, weathered clothing
hobbies: carving small figures from scrap wood
collecting books from before the collapse
listening to the old radio at night
playing chess with pieces made of scrap
quirks: keeping a pocket full of tiny useful bolts
never wasting a single scrap of food
whistling to keep the quiet away
naming every machine that comes through the workshop
carrying a photograph from before the collapse everywhere
sniffing the air before entering a room
collecting old keys that open nothing
saving the label from every tin
patching {poss} coat with a new scrap every week
goals: getting the generator running for good
raising a crop that survives the dust
earning a seat on the settlement council
building a wall no raider can climb
teaching every child in the settlement to read
opening the first tavern in the settlement
peeves: people who leave the gate open
accessories: a gas mask hanging at the neck
a battered canteen on a strap
a scavenged wristwatch that still ticks
a bundle of copper wire over the shoulder
a hand-cranked radio on the belt
a pair of welding goggles pushed up on the forehead
a hand-drawn map in a tube
a lucky bolt on a leather cord
a slingshot tucked in the belt
default_outfits: a patched canvas jacket over a faded sweatshirt, cargo trousers with leather-patched knees and mismatched boots wrapped in duct tape
a long knitted cardigan over a worn shirt, patched trousers held up with rope and sturdy boots
a quilted vest sewn from old blankets over a torn long-sleeved shirt, layered scarves, worn cargo pants and scuffed boots
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): practical hair, no dye, no salon, and leaner builds.
